Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
          definition:
          obs:Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u | u.LoanedBook->exists(l | l.OverDue3Days or l.OverDue10Days or l.OverDue17Days or l.OverDue31Days))
            
            precondition:
          obs->notEmpty()
            
            postcondition:
          obs->forAll(u:User | u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays - 1 and (u.SuspensionDays <= 0) implies u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND)
            
        }
